get_deepseek_v4_tokenizer: wrap a HuggingFace tokenizer to use the custom DeepSeek V4 chat template encoding
apply_chat_template_with_thinking: apply the DeepSeek V4 chat template to messages with thinking mode and reasoning effort
apply_chat_template_with_tools: apply the DeepSeek V4 chat template to messages with tool definitions for function calling
deepseek_v4_tokenizer_from_pretrained: load a pretrained tokenizer and wrap it with the DeepSeek V4 chat template encoding
num_special_tokens_to_add: get the number of special tokens the DeepSeek V4 tokenizer adds to empty input
